reviews.comment: Did amazing work for me on my total roof replacement. It was easy to work with Sawtooth Customs on my roof. They answered questions I had and helped me with the process as a homeowner using my insurance company. I highly recommend using their business. Thank you Anthony and Josh.
Caden was very helpful through the whole process! Very happy with the results
Caden was awesome! Definitely check these guys out :-)
Caden was so helpful! Thanks !!

We had an urgent issue when water started coming into our home through an exterior wall near the chimney, and Sawtooth Customs showed up immediately. From the start, Josh and his team were incredibly honest and transparent. They even let us know we had the option to pursue the previous roofer under Idaho law that would have saved us thousands. That level of integrity is rare!

We ultimately chose to move forward with Josh and Sawtooth Customs, and it was absolutely the right decision. Not only did they fix the original issue, but they uncovered additional problems that could have turned into serious damage down the road and took care of everything without charging us extra.

It’s hard to find contractors you can fully trust, but this team operates with true character and professionalism. You can tell they genuinely care about doing things the right way and taking care of their customers. If you’re in the Treasure Valley and need quality work done by people you can trust, Sawtooth Customs is the team to call.

Sawtooth Customs delivered exceptional service on our roof. Their team was professional, efficient, and clearly skilled—the quality of their workmanship truly stands out. Our new roof looks fantastic, and the entire process was smooth from start to finish. They are a reliable company well-equipped to handle a wide range of roofing needs.

These guys are the real deal. It’s not often contractors live up to their word completely. The job was done just as I had imagined it, they did what they said they were going to do. If you’re looking at getting your roof done or re-done, don’t hesitate to call them up. I appreciate that they aren’t pushy, have reasonable quotes, and are friendly. Definitely would recommend.
Great people, great service
Great guys, helped me fix my roof after it started leaking a few months ago. They were quick, and it was reasonably priced. Haven't had a leak since!
Decent folks doing honest work
Caden was fantastic to work with. Always very quick when I needed him, and made the process fun!
Very good customer service

5 Stars - Highly Recommend!
We recently had Sawtooth Customs replace our roof and couldn't be happier with the results. From start to finish, they were professional, efficient, and did exceptional work. The crew showed up on time, worked hard throughout the project, and left our property spotless when they finished. The quality of their craftsmanship is top-notch, and the pricing was fair and transparent with no surprises. Communication was great too - they kept us informed every step of the way. If you need roofing work done, don't hesitate to call Sawtooth Customs. We'd hire them again in a heartbeat!
Great work, couldn’t even tell the roof had previous damage at all once they finished it up!

They also worked directly with our insurance company to help us get the most coverage, which made the whole process so much easier. Our new roof looks great, and we highly recommend them for any roofing needs.
